discovery.Futures

Class to get the futures contracts of an underlying that expire within a date range.

Available as lseg.data.discovery.Futures.

Syntax

Futures(universe: str | list[str], start: str, end: str)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
universe str | list[str] Yes A single instrument (RIC, Org PermId or RICRoot) as a string or a list containing one instrument.
start str Yes The start date for the futures data. String format is: '%Y-%m-%d'.
end str Yes The end date for the futures data. String format is: '%Y-%m-%d'.

Methods

get_data

Get the futures contracts of the universe expiring between start and end.

get_data()

Returns

pd.DataFrame

Futures contracts sorted by expiry date; empty if no contract is found.

Example

from lseg.data.discovery import Futures
futures = Futures(universe="ES", start="2020-01-01", end="2025-12-31")
data = futures.get_data()
